messages:
Maya: who's up for a 3-point tiebreaker tomorrow? loser brings chili. 😂
Jordan: i'm in — but my 3pt% is tragic. someone bring milk.
Priya: putting $5 on Marco. he's been practicing at lunch.
Marco: lol i've been practicing... in my living room? only layups tbh :joy:
Avery: quick poll — best-of-3 or sudden death? react :one: for Bo3, :two: for SD
Maya: Bo3 seems fair. also who wants to claim the kitchen at 6pm for the watch + shootout
Sam: scheduling note: kitchen reserved 5:45–7:30, @katie set the table last time
Katie: can do setup, i'll bring napkins and a small cooler for the milk 🌶️🥶
bracket-bot: New bracket update — 3 players added to shootout: Jordan, Priya, Marco. Link: https://tiny.redwood/3ptshoot
ops-bot: FYI security asked we keep the fire lane clear near the west stairs — avoid setting up behind the mailboxes
Priya: sign-up format (so Maya can run bracket):
```
name: <your-name>
time-slot: <6:00 | 6:15 | 6:30>
entry: $5
```
Jordan: signed up: name: Jordan time-slot: 6:15 entry: $5
Marco: signed up: Marco 6:00 $5
Avery: i'll seed the bracket and DM Maya the schedule
Maya: perfect. loser chili rule enforced. if tie after Bo3, tiebreaker = longest made 3 in 30s. pressure cooker.
Sam: can we also make a side bet for 'best celebratory victory dance'? i'll bring a little trophy 🏆
Katie: i'll judge dances. objective criteria: enthusiasm, creativity, and embarrassment level
Maya: okay it's official. see you all 6pm. bring napkins, wallet, and dignity. :thumbsup:
